title: Fix logic bugs — conditions that always evaluate to same value across 5 files
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
7 instances of conditional expressions that always evaluate to the same value, indicating dead code or logic errors:
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` (L3022)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Pages.razor` (L1105)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/TopicMapVisualization.razor` (L54)
- `MemorySmith.App/Controllers/McpController.cs` (L84)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatServices.cs` (L746, L1863, L2149)

## Impact
Logic bugs — code paths are either always taken or always skipped, meaning some branches are dead code. These may mask real issues where the condition was intended to be dynamic.

## Action Required
Review each condition's boolean logic, fix the expression or remove the dead branch. Verify with tests.

## Effort
~1h45min

## Priority
P0 — Bug
